subject: Approval requested: HarperTech marketplace custom listing — rev-share & payment terms
messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@harpertech.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Harvard Procurement <procurement@harpertech.com>, AWS Marketplace <marketplace-support@amazon.com>
Date: 2028-08-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Marketplace private listing request: HarperTech — custom split & payment terms

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for taking time yesterday. Attached is the term sheet HarperTech is proposing for a private listing on AWS Marketplace. High level: HarperTech is committing to an initial 12-month pilot that we expect to convert into a broader deployment. Projected first-year committed spend is $650k.

Key asks from the customer:
- 25% rev-share to HarperTech for the first 12 months (they argue higher co-selling split due to channeling and joint GTM spend)
- Net45 payment terms (they have corporate policy)
- One-time $50k marketplace marketing credit applied up-front
- Listing limited to AWS commercial regions (no GovCloud initially)

They've attached a draft SOW and the term sheet (HarperTech_Marketplace_Term_Sheet_v3.pdf). Can you confirm whether Redwood can accept 25% for year one and Net45? If not, what counter would you recommend?

Sanjay Rao
VP Partnerships, HarperTech
Attachments: HarperTech_Marketplace_Term_Sheet_v3.pdf, HarperTech_SOW_Draft.xlsx
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@harpertech.com>
Date: 2028-08-09T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Marketplace private listing request: HarperTech — custom split & payment terms

Team — forwarding HarperTech's ask. Summary: 12-month pilot, $650k expected first-year spend, asking for 25% rev-share (vs our target 18–20%) and Net45 + $50k up-front marketing credit. They want this as a private listing on AWS commercial regions only.

What I need:
- Karthik: quick deal economics (what's the incremental margin impact for 25% for first year; does the $50k get treated as marketing credit vs revenue deduction?)
- Marissa: finance approval for Net45 and credit treatment; will this create cashflow issues given the size?
- Jonas: exec sign-off required for non-standard rev-share >22% and payment-term exceptions.

Desired timeline: HarperTech wants an answer by EOD tomorrow to keep AWS listing slot. I'm proposing a conditional approval path: approve 25% for first 12 months if they sign the attached SOW and accept an audit clause + revert to 18% thereafter. Also require PO and DocuSign execution.

I've attached their term sheet. If you want a quick call, I can set up 30 min with Sanjay at 11:30 PT.

- Neha
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-08-09T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Marketplace private listing request: HarperTech — custom split & payment terms

Thanks Neha — quick notes after a first pass on the term sheet:
- Rev-share impact: at $650k ARR, moving from 18% → 25% increases our cost of revenue to the account by ~$45.5k in year one (simple calc).
- Marketing credit: $50k can be treated as co-op marketing (not revenue reduction) if credited to a marketing spend line; we need finance confirmation.
- Payment terms: Net45 is atypical for marketplace deals (we usually invoice monthly via marketplace flows). Net45 increases receivable window and could push collections to Net60 given processing.

Suggested controls if we approve:
1) 25% rev-share limited to AWS commercial listing only and only while the committed spend threshold ($600k) is met.
2) Confirm the $50k is marketing co-op and requires proof of spend/landing page performance metrics.
3) Revert to standard 18% after 12 months automatically unless an amendment is signed.
4) Add audit rights and a 30-day cure on missed payments; if payment delayed >60 days, rev-share reverts immediately.

Marissa — flagged to you for formal finance sign-off and cashflow impact.

- Karthik
Head of Deal Desk, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-08-09T15:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Marketplace private listing request: HarperTech — custom split & payment terms

Neha / Karthik — Finance has reviewed. We can approve the request with the following binding conditions:

1) Approve 25% rev-share for the first 12 months only, capped to $250k of paid rev-share (protects downstream margin if spend exceeds forecast).
2) $50k to be issued as a marketing credit (co-op) — Redwood pays upon verification of marketing deliverables tied to the marketplace listing. Credit is not accounted as revenue reduction.
3) Payment terms approved as Net45 for Redwood invoices, but the customer must submit a signed PO and execute the DocuSign term sheet prior to listing. If payment goes >45 days past due, Redwood may withhold future rev-share payments until cure.
4) Limit listing to AWS commercial regions; no GovCloud without a separate security review.

I attached the term sheet with the finance redlines (approved_term_sheet_neha_signed.pdf). Legal still needs to confirm the audit clause language — please loop Legal (I recommend legal@redwood.ai) before DocuSign final.

If these conditions are acceptable to HarperTech we can provisionally proceed to AWS listing setup.

-Marissa Cole
Finance, Redwood Inference
Attachments: approved_term_sheet_neha_signed.pdf
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Sanjay Rao <sanjay@harpertech.com>
Date: 2028-08-09T17:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Marketplace private listing request: HarperTech — custom split & payment terms

Approved with conditions — thanks team for the quick triage. Final executive decision:
- Approve 25% rev-share for the first 12 months (subject to the $250k cap Marissa noted).
- Approve Net45 conditional on execution of the PO + DocuSign and inclusion of explicit audit and recoverability language in the contract.
- Require marketing co-op milestones for release of the $50k credit (benchmarks in the attached redline).

Neha / Karthik: proceed to get HarperTech to sign the DocuSign and route the final redlined term sheet to AWS Marketplace for listing. Copy Legal (legal@redwood.ai) on the DocuSign envelope for final verification. Once executed, we will provision listing and set the rev-share schedule in our billing system.

Sanjay — welcome aboard. We'll aim to finalize paperwork by EOD tomorrow if you can return the signed PO.

Jonas Weber
VP, GTM Strategy, Redwood Inference
